articles.title: Coinbase's corporate customers can now accept payments from AI agents
articles.snippet: Rolling out this week, Coinbase Business users will be able to accept payments from AI agents, done via the x402 protocol, developed and incubated by the exchange.

articles.title: Abu Dhabi's Mubadala Capital joins tokenization push as Coinbase takes stake in onchain fund
articles.snippet: The sovereign wealth-backed asset manager tapped KAIO to bring one of its private market funds onchain across Base, Solana and Sui networks.

articles.title: Key Democratic lawmakers say crypto Clarity Act 'falls short' on ethics, other issues
articles.snippet: Several of the Democrats most likely to vote for the crypto market structure bill said they had issues with the new draft published by Republicans earlier in the day.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Wall Street Moving Onchain Will Drive the Next Bull Market
articles.snippet: At least that's what Bitwise's CIO believes. Plus Republicans publish new Clarity Act draft, and the SEC Commissioner has a warning for DeFi.

articles.title: Jack Dorsey's Block Launches Buzz, a Nostr-Based Slack and GitHub Rival for AI Agents
articles.snippet: The free, open source workspace runs on Nostr, gives AI agents their own cryptographic identities, and challenges Slack and GitHub.
